extracted.name: Chocolate Cake Mix Cookies
extracted.description: These chocolate cake mix cookies are quick and easy to make with just 4 ingredients for super fudgy, decadent treats studded with chocolate chips.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Stir together cake mix, butter, and eggs in a large bowl until smooth and well blended. Mix in chocolate chips until incorporated. Drop by spoonfuls onto ungreased baking sheets.
Bake in the preheated oven until edges are set, 8 to 10 minutes. Cool cookies on the baking sheets for 5 minutes before removing to a wire rack to cool completely.
